name: CYGNO Collaboration
notes: Roster not published in the sources read. The hall of the collaboration's host site is Hall F (no site record); site:lngs-hall-b is the facility's primary site.

summary.plain: The team of INFN, Coimbra, Sheffield and other groups that develops the CYGNO optical-readout gas detector for directional dark matter at Gran Sasso.
summary.technical: CYGNO (CYGNus module with Optical readout) collaboration: INFN (Frascati, Gran Sasso, Rome), Gran Sasso Science Institute, Sapienza and Roma Tre, University of Coimbra, Federal University of Juiz de Fora and the University of Sheffield, per the affiliations of arXiv:2603.22595; part of the CYGNUS proto-collaboration (arXiv:2202.05480). Funded in part by the ERC Consolidator Grant INITIUM.
